o.text: From dörd + -üncü. Cognate with Kazakh төртінші (törtinši), Turkmen dördünji, Turkish dördüncü.
Sense 2 (“multiplication”) is a calque of Arabic ضَرْب (ḍarb).
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish آزغون (azġun). By surface analysis, az- + -ğın.
